sections.Overview of Optima Secure: HDFC ERGO's Optima Secure stands out in the health insurance landscape by offering 4X coverage of your original sum insured (2X from day 1 and 3X after two consecutive years). ensuring peace of mind for individuals and families alike. Add to this a vast, cashless hospital network of over 13,000 facilities, wellness benefits, and high flexibility in sum insured (from ₹5 lakh up to ₹2 crore), and you have a plan that is both extensive and future-ready.
sections.Experts' Review of Optima Secure: Written by Nikhil Nair Senior Writer Reviewed by Gaurav Bhat Senior Editor IRDAI-Certified Expert
sections.Pros: Offers a wide range of features. Premiums are relatively well priced. Insurer has a solid track record with great claim and service metrics. Offers 2x Secure Benefit, which makes this policy stand out. You can pick any room you like, a highly valued feature. Good Restoration Benefit, which adds significant value to the policy.
sections.Cons: Maternity benefits not offered, which is a notable gap. Need to opt add-on for maternity cover. Doctor consultations are not covered, which could be a drawback for some. Need to opt add-on for doctor consultations.
sections.Founded: 2002 HDFC Ergo was established 24 years ago and has built strong credibility over time, backed by its long-standing presence in the market.
sections.Claims Experience: 98% CSR, calculated as a 3-year average HDFC Ergo settles 98% of all claims it receives demonstrating strong credibility.
sections.Network Hospitals: 16,000+ HDFC Ergo has a strong network with over 16,000 hospitals, ensuring wide accessibility and convenience for policyholders.
sections.Complaints: 9 complaints per 10,000 claims registered HDFC Ergo maintains a low volume of complaints, reflecting strong customer satisfaction and effective service.
sections.Add-ons of Optima Secure:
Unlimited Restoration Recommended Restores the cover unlimited times up to 100% of the sum insured for any illness. ABCD Chronic Care Recommended For Asthma, Hypertension, Cholesterol, Diabetes: Pre existing disease waiting period is reduced from 3 years to 30 days. Optima Well-being Recommended Each insured member can avail of unlimited tele and in-clinic consultations with General Physicians from network-partnered facilities. Additionally, one can avail of free home sample collection and discounts on tests taken from partnered facilities. They can also take unlimited online fitness classes, counselling sessions for mental health, diet and nutrition from partnered facilities. Aggregate Deductible Choose deductible between ₹25,000 and ₹5,00,000 and get a discount on premiums. Parenthood Maternity expenses covered between ₹50,000 and ₹2,00,000 after a waiting period of 2 years. Reduction in PED For any illness: Pre existing disease waiting period is modified/reduced from 3 years to 1 and 2 years.(This add-on is not live yet) Hospital Cash Hospital cash benefit paid out if hospitalization is at least 1 day, with a maximum payout of ₹1000 to 2000 for up to 30 days. Individual Personal Accident Paid out as a lump sum of 500% of sum insured for Accidental Death, Total Permanent Disability, Permanent Partial Disability up to a limit of ₹10,000,000, applicable only for the proposer. Critical Illness Paid out as a lump sum amount for listed Critical illnesses based on the cover chosen. Limitless Unlimited coverage (without any upper cap) for a specified number of claims during the Policy lifetime. Serious Illness Booster Provides an additional 100% of your Sum Insured as coverage for 9 specified serious illnesses.
This add-on is currently offered by HDFC Ergo but is not yet available through us.
sections.Exclusions in Optima Secure: Conditions or treatments that the policy clearly says it will not cover. Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes are excluded. Diagnostic expenses not related or incidental to current diagnosis and treatment are excluded. Expenses for admission primarily for bed rest and not for treatment are excluded. Custodial care at home or in a facility for help with daily activities is excluded. Services for terminally ill individuals addressing non-medical needs are excluded. View all exclusions
sections.Specific Illness: The following illnesses are not covered under the policy for 2 years. Non-infective arthritis Pilonidal sinus Diseases of the gallbladder, including cholecystitis Calculus diseases of the urogenital system (e.g., kidney stones, urinary bladder stones) Benign tumors, cysts, nodules, polyps (including breast lumps) View all illnesses

sections.Reviews for Optima Secure: R Rukmini Achanta Bought a ₹10 lakh cover and was insured for ₹20 lakh from day one. No waiting, no claim-free years to earn it. Two years in, the Plus Benefit had pushed it further still. Most plans make you wait a decade for that kind of growth. T Tejas Ghorpade The Protect Benefit is the sleeper feature. My father's knee replacement generated close to ₹70,000 in consumables gloves, syringes, surgical items and every rupee was paid. On our previous policy that entire column was non-payable and came out of pocket. S Sharmila Venkatesh Post-hospitalisation runs 180 days, which covered my mother's entire rehabilitation after a stroke. Pre-hospitalisation at 60 days caught the diagnostics too. Very few plans give you a six-month tail. A Aarushi Kohli Got the 5% lifetime discount since both of us were under 35, plus a discount for paying three years upfront. Premium landed lower than I'd braced for given the coverage. C Chirag Thakkar Took the ABCD Chronic Care add-on for my hypertension and the waiting period dropped from three years to thirty days. Worth knowing that's a paid add-on and has to be paid for every year, not part of the base plan. I'd assumed otherwise from the way it's marketed. sections.Frequently Asked Questions:
Does Optima Secure have waiting periods? Yes. Optima Secure imposes 3 kinds of waiting periods - 30-Day Waiting Period: Hospitalizations won’t be covered for the first 30 days of the policy unless it’s an accident. Specific Illness Waiting Period: There’s a 2-year waiting period for a list of diseases which is a mandate before you can start claiming. Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: There's a 3-year waiting period for any pre-existing disease you may have while buying the policy. Does Optima Secure have room rent restrictions? No. Optima Secure lets you stay in any room available in the hospital - Single Private Room, Share Room, Deluxe Room, etc. Does Optima Secure offer a restoration benefit? Yes, Optima Secure does offer a restoration benefit. You will have 100% of the cover restored, so that you can use this benefit in the event you have to endure multiple hospitalizations, in a policy year. Does Optima Secure cover AYUSH treatments? Yes. Optima Secure does cover AYUSH Treatments. Does Optima Secure offer a bonus? Yes. Optima Secure offers a bonus. Every year on renewal, your sum insured grows by 50% up to a maximum of 100% of the sum insured. Does Optima Secure offer maternity benefits? Yes. Optima Secure does offer maternity benefits - packaged as an optional cover/add-on. Does Optima Secure offer international coverage? No. Optima Secure does not offer international coverage. Does Optima Secure offer dental protection? Yes. Optima Secure does offer dental treatments in case of injury or accidents. Does Optima Secure offer coverage for outpatient consultations? Yes. Optima Secure does offer Outpatient Consultations - packaged as an optional cover/add-on. How are the premiums calculated for Optima Secure? The premiums are calculated after taking into account your age, your location (zonal), your medical condition, (any pre-existing diseases), and lifestyle habits (smoking, drinking, etc.) Can I avail myself of a discount on Optima Secure? Yes. Optima Secure does provide a discount. The insurer offers a discount of 6% on the overall premium amount if you pay for 2 year policy term in advance and a discount of 8% on the overall premium if you pay for 3 year policy term in advance. Lifetime Discount of 5%
is available only if the eldest member is ≤35 years at entry and is applicable for fresh policies only.
Once applied, it continues at renewals. Does Optima Secure have entry and exit restrictions? Yes. This policy has an entry age of 18 years with no exit age. However, it provides coverage for dependent children from the age of 3 months to 25 years. View all
